description: "dismiss" (or all: true) marks alerts seen; they move to history. "set_settings" sets, per alert type, who gets it, by which channels and any filter (purchase: filter { minAmount: { amount, currency } }); activity types (sales, sign-ups…) stay off until given a channel. Telegram: each person links it once in the panel. Values inherit account → project → app, field by field. "test" sends a real test message. Applies at once. More: neblla_get_llms tools/alerts

action.description: What to do. By action: dismiss {id}; test {via, to?}

appId.description: The app (not needed with scope "project" or "account").

discord.description: set_settings: a Discord webhook URL; null forgets it.

pushFull.description: set_settings: true lets the back office app's push show the users' words.

scope.description: set_settings: app (default), project or account (account owner only). The daily_report type: project or account only.

slack.description: set_settings: a Slack incoming webhook URL; null forgets it.

telegramFull.description: set_settings: true lets Telegram show the users' words.

to.description: test by email: "owner" or a team member's email.

types.description: set_settings: { <type from neblla_alerts_read settings>: { to?: ["owner" | team email], via?: [channel], filter? } | null }; null inherits.

name: neblla_alerts
title: Manage alerts
